messages:
Olivia Chen: Morning — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9421 fixes a kv-cache mem leak we saw in prod during the midnight run. CI is green but we need a second signoff before the cutover window at 07:00 PT (14:00 UTC). Can someone give a quick OK? /cc @Javier @Sam

Sam Patel: I'll pull and run the smoke tests now. quick skim looks fine, just a tiny comment inline.

Javier Morales: Skimming — logic LGTM. One note about explicit lock release in store.go line 128, add a defer unlock or comment why it's safe. If that's a quick follow-up I'm okay not blocking the cutover.

Olivia Chen: The defer would change the control flow; I can add a short patch but it'll alter the diff size. Is a post-cutover follow-up acceptable? We need to decide within the hour.

merge-bot: CI: ✅ all checks passed. Auto-merge is disabled until 2 approvers are present.

Mae Lin: I can be the second approver but need staging smoke green. @Sam can you confirm staging results? Smoke command: `./scripts/smoke.sh --env staging --seed 42` :thumbsup:

Sam Patel: Running now on staging. so far no mem spikes, basic p95 latency looks normal. will report back in ~5m.

Sam Patel: staging smoke ✅ — no leaks, no errors in logs. re-run with `LOG_LEVEL=debug` to double-check KV warmup path.

Mae Lin: Thanks — reviewing now. leaving a quick inline approving comment. once I add my approval, someone can /merge during the window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Mae Lin: APPROVED :white_check_mark:

Olivia Chen: Great — @Mae thanks! @Javier if you're still good with deferring the lock tweak, can you drop a quick approval so we hit 2? otherwise I can hold and do the tiny follow-up.

Javier Morales: dropping approval. APPROVED. :thumbsup:

merge-bot: Action: PR #9421 marked approved by Mae Lin, Javier Morales. Ready for merge during cutover.

Olivia Chen: Copy — I'll merge at 14:05 UTC (after the traffic-steady signal). Thanks all for the quick turn.
